speaker: Doctor

Given your severe headache, visual symptoms, and anorexia at 30 weeks gestation, have you noticed any sensitivity to light, neck stiffness, or any change in your mental status like confusion?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood_Cultures: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium. Viral_Serology: Pending

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Botulism (Maternal-Horizontal Transmission)

The blood culture findings of Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are pathognomonic for *Clostridium botulinum*, which explains your fever, headache, and anorexia at 30 weeks gestation. Please confirm if you have noticed any changes in your speech, swallowing, or eye movements, as these are critical for immediate management.
